EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Points have been credited to your account
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.Name},
We apologise that your recent experience with us was not to the standard we’ve long held ourselves to. In acknowledgement of this we've credited {!Case.Recovery_Quantity__c} Qantas Points to your Qantas Frequent Flyer account.
If you have any questions regarding your Qantas Points, please contact the Qantas Frequent Flyer team on 13 13 13.
We appreciate your continued support.
Thank you,
The Qantas Frequent Flyer Team
